programme.title: Bear vs. Shark

programme.sub-title: A Sea Lion Pup Grows Up
programme.desc: Zoo staff face unexpected setbacks weaning a bright sea lion pup off its mother's milk the bird team steps in to support a rejected curassow chick a squirrel monkey visits the dentist.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Baier suspects a ferret suffers from a spinal injury after being attacked by the family canine Dr. Jeff travels to a wolf sanctuary to spay and neuter a desperate pack of wolf-hybrids three dogs are rescued from an overcrowded shelter.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Feeding Frenzy
programme.desc: Andrea Schlake volunteers at an animal sanctuary when a chimpanzee escapes its enclosure and chases her down a great white shark knocks surfer Todd Endris off his board and attacks him.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Bosco the Croc's Big Move
programme.desc: Robert takes on the challenging task of relocating Bosco, the most aggressive croc at the zoo Bindi must investigate Forest the giraffe's bad knee problem Terri helps Harley the koala find love at the end of a difficult breeding season.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Kitty, Can You Hear Me?
programme.desc: Hostile repeat offender Mow Mow is stuck in yet another tree in Eatonville Shaun is called to rescue his first-ever deaf cat, Snow, in Seattle.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: After a long road to recovery, a golden eagle is ready for its debut at the Eagle Aviary exhibit.

programme.title: Crikey! It's Shark Week
programme.desc: Robert Irwin comes face to face with a great white shark for the first time with shark conservationists Paul de Gelder and Madison Stewart following in his father's footsteps, he will get as close as possible to these incredible creatures.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Beloved camel Max develops a large abscess on the top of his head a marmot prepares for her first classroom visit as an ambassador animal a peregrine falcon found at the base of a skyscraper is brought to the zoo for a health check.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
